caveats: Labels are GPT-6 qualitative judgments, not human Gold or established JEV precision.
Auditor knows the proposed theme/polarity and the filter's original status; this is not a fully blinded independent annotation experiment.
Only preexisting English resolved translations were considered; source-language translation fidelity was not independently checked.
Excluded group is a census of the 65 V2.1 exclusions; the other strata are deterministically sampled, nonproportional. Do not extrapolate raw percentages to all 1580 JEV associations.
Audit verdict 'supported' means an explicit text signal is present under the V12 thematic boundaries; 'unsupported' means it is not evidenced; 'uncertain' is genuinely ambiguous.
No label is an instruction to modify historical JEV results, past reports, existing benchmarks or V12/V13 configurations.

sampling.excluded: Complete enumeration of 65 unsupported_by_rule cases, sorted by theme_key, polarity, review_id.
sampling.balanced_review_needed: 10 per axis × polarity (8 strata, n=80), SHA/MD5 deterministic order md5(binding_id || ':pilot-gpt6-review-20261011').
sampling.targeted_review_needed: 8 per specified theme/polarity (professionalism:positive, attentiveness:positive, food_quality:positive, price_level:negative), excluding prior 80; ranked md5(binding_id || ':pilot-gpt6-target-20261011'), n=32.
sampling.accepted_controls: Up to 3 per axis × polarity, total n=22, ordered md5(binding_id || ':pilot-gpt6-control-20261011').

examples.assessment: Explicitly says staff checked whether everything was okay; V2.1 excluded an arguably correct JEV association.
A fan was brought immediately on request and a meal adjusted to preference, a concrete response to customer needs.
Shakshuka and pastry are explicitly described as delicious, though V2.1 marks the association unsupported.
Explicit says prices justify quality; V2.1 falsely excludes as price/value confusion.
Top-notch service alone does not establish professional competence or professional conduct.
Communication difficulty alone does not establish lack of customer attentiveness.
Unassuming location is not a clear adverse judgement about distance/access.
Above-average prices described as worthwhile support value, not a positive appraisal of low price level.
An explicitly untrained new waiter without supervision is relevant professional competence evidence.
Historical mold/cleanliness complaint was reportedly remedied later; temporal status must be preserved without inferring illness causation.
